products.name: Weaviate
products.note: Open-source vector DB; GraphQL interface; EU-hosted; GDPR; hybrid search

profile_text.body:
Weaviate is a database company that develops an open-source vector database aimed at developers building AI-native applications. The company describes its product as designed to reduce hallucination, data leakage, and vendor lock-in in AI applications. Its database offers a GraphQL interface, hybrid search capabilities, EU-hosted deployment options, and GDPR compliance.

The Weaviate database is tracked as a coding and developer tool, and the company also offers a managed cloud service under the Weaviate Cloud brand alongside deployment, agent, and LLM-focused documentation and guides. Supporting resources include a learning center, blog, academy, knowledge cards, paper reviews, and a community forum, reflecting a developer-oriented positioning. No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings are present in the held facts.
